title: Gradient regularity for viscosity solutions to quasilinear parabolic equations with mixed singular-degenerate structure
summary: We establish regularity results for viscosity solutions to a class of quasilinear parabolic equations exhibiting nonhomogeneous degeneracy or singularity (a double phase regime) of the form \[ u_t - \big(|Du|^{\mathfrak{p}} + \mathfrak{a}(x,t)|Du|^{\mathfrak{q}}\big)Δ_p^{\mathrm N} u = f(x,t) \quad \text{in } Q_1, \] where $-1 < \mathfrak{p} < 0$, $\mathfrak{p} \leq \mathfrak{q}$, and $\mathfrak{a}, f : Q_1 \to \mathbb{R}$ are prescribed functions.
